# Ranking Digital Rights

> A comprehensive accountability platform that ranks technology and telecommunications companies on their digital rights practices, privacy protections, and freedom of expression commitments.

Ranking Digital Rights (RDR) is an independent research organization that conducts rigorous assessments of major tech and telecom companies through its Corporate Accountability Index and specialized scorecards. The organization combines research, policy engagement, and investor advocacy to advance digital rights standards globally.

## Key Topics

- digital rights
- corporate accountability
- privacy
- freedom of expression
- content moderation
- tech governance

## Rankings & Scorecards

- [Scorecards & Rankings - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/rankings-report-cards): Central hub for RDR scorecards including Telco Giants, Big Tech, and Corporate Accountability Index
- [Ranking Digital Rights - The 2025 Big Tech Edition](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/bte25): 2025 Big Tech ranking surveying Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta, Apple on privacy and free expression
- [Ranking Digital Rights - The 2022 RDR Big Tech Scorecard](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/bts22): 2022 Big Tech scorecard ranking Twitter, Yahoo, Microsoft, Google on privacy and expression

## Organization & Mission

- [Home - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org): Homepage for Ranking Digital Rights, introducing CLARITI and digital rights accountability mission
- [Who We Are - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/who-we-are): Organizational overview of RDR mission, leadership, and Corporate Accountability Index work
- [RDR Research Lab - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/research-lab): RDR Research Lab focusing on digital rights, state repression, and tech governance in Iran

## Policy & Investor Engagement

- [Policy Engagement - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/policy-projects): Policy engagement work including shareholder advocacy with Meta and SEC compliance initiatives
- [Investor guidance - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/investor-guidance): Guidance for shareholders on tech company governance, AI, and AGM season advocacy
- [Global Engagement - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/global-engagement): Global partnerships and regional adaptations with Digital Rights Center Qazaqstan, GLAAD, Derechos Digitales

## Research & Analysis

- [It's the Business Model](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/its-the-business-model): Two-part policy series examining Big Tech business models and platform regulation recommendations
- [Red Card on Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/red-card-series): Investigative report on digital rights and surveillance during Qatar FIFA World Cup 2022
- [News - Ranking Digital Rights](https://rankingdigitalrights.org/news): News and updates on RDR research, methodology, and accountability standards for tech companies
